decisions.scope: this verifier fills the per-mode + negative gaps the focused E2–E6 verifiers left; it does not duplicate their assertions
decisions.pathSafety: resolveSafeEditPath rejects '..' and symlink escapes before any file is touched
decisions.renameSafety: refactor skips heredoc, block comment, and interpolation text (never rewrites string/comment content)
decisions.formatterTruth: D5: `formatted` is MEASURED per file (BrainSurgicalPatcher.tryAutoFormat reports which formatter ran and whether it exited 0); the formatter is resolved from node_modules/.bin/PATH and invoked with execFile, so nothing in a file NAME can be shell-expanded

limitations: Comprehensive cross-language rename classification is proven in E2 (65 checks); E7 adds only the per-mode and adversarial-fixture gaps.

The formatter branches use a fake node_modules/.bin/prettier written by the gate, so they are deterministic whether or not a formatter is installed (and command resolution is PATH-scrubbed where it matters); the rewrite proof uses that fake's own output bytes.
